method: Source audit, real exported H5 mouse/touch routes, actual browser save-file transfer, fault-injected persistence tests and visual inspection. Reading fixtures are explicitly synthetic and separate from normal gameplay.

findings.finding: CSS window size and framebuffer pixel size selected different layouts at high DPI.
findings.change: One CSS viewport calculation shared by game and DOM; safe-area-aware frame; fullscreen hidden while panels are open.

findings.finding: Text size did not reach notebook/codex/reasoning; some controls were too small.
findings.change: Shared reading font scale, measured scrolling text, larger sliders, confirmation and navigation buttons. Corrected large-font hint clipping found during review.

findings.finding: No portable backup or corrupt-save recovery.
findings.change: Checksum-protected seven-slot/profile archive, full validation, confirmation, pre-import snapshot, rolling valid copies, error disclosure and partial-write rollback.

findings.finding: Fixed conclusion position and overly direct reasoning.
findings.change: Persisted shuffled conclusion positions, related evidence required in both puzzles, three player-requested hints, wrong evidence/conclusion remains recoverable.

findings.finding: Repeated bridge plates and abrupt scene/mechanism changes.
findings.change: Bridge size/angle/tone variations and repair blend, leaf rotation animation, ice/sand reveal, ambient portrait tint; reduced-motion mode respected.
New actual H5 recording of both routes and chapter replay for the third ending, original game audio and chapter navigation.

limits: Physical iOS/Android and WeChat/Douyin embedded-browser testing pending
